Separating Access Scope While Keeping kubectl
kubectlを使い続けながらアクセス範囲を分ける
Kubernetes teams use kubectl daily and should not need a web UI for every check. I connected through Multi Agent, read a ConfigMap, attempted a change, and checked role-based handling in QueryPie.
Kubernetes運用ではkubectlが日常の道具だ。確認ごとにWebへ移らず、Multi Agent経由でConfigMapの参照・変更を試し、役割ごとの処理を確認した。
Kubernetes teams often use kubectl. I wanted to inspect settings with familiar commands rather than switch to a web screen every time.
Kubernetesを扱うならkubectlをよく使う。確認のたびWebへ移らず慣れたコマンドで見たい。
